sources.title: iimran/EmotionDetection · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository hosts a fine-tuned emotion detection model built on BERT-base-cased. The model is trained on the ma2za/many_emotions dataset to classify text into one of seven emotion categories: anger, fear, joy, love, sadness, surprise, and neutral. The model is available in both PyTorch and ONNX formats for efficient deployment.
